comments.text:
Rice comes from Asia. And in Asia we eat with chopsticks or use our fingers. And, when we use cutlery, it's with a spoon and fork. It's the efficient and satisfying way to do it. We don't really need to follow every mindless standard that our former colonial masters set. 
Having said that, you look lovely and elegant, like a rare and dazzling bloom ❤
